author: Dawudis
body:
Greetings everyone, I had recently just made a new team called ShotsFired. I have three members including myself, LegendaryBlade, and Burningtaco. I was wondering if any people who have the skill, and guts to fight different players can join my team. Cause that is all you need. We also need confidence a sense of seriousness and competition. However, do not feel to pressured, as we are a little laid back and not to strict.

How to apply? Simple.
